What sensor are you using?

> I think that the best way to get into the code is with a small feature or a small bug.

miaomiao with libre, i have the GlucoNightSentry aswell as the blucon nightrider.

Libre creates a reading every 1 minute.
xDrip can only set it once every 5 minutes.
Some people have asked that xdrip will also show the per minute data.
Changing all places in xDrip is probably too much, but reading the data and
showing it in libre trend is feasible.
Do you want to implement that?
